pairs.title: Nigerian naira in US dollars
pairs.description: How many US dollars ₦1,000 buys. A rising number means a stronger Nigerian naira. Starts in 1999, with the unified exchange rate of 1999; earlier official rates were fixed, not market rates.
pairs.source: World Bank series PA.NUS.FCRF · official exchange rate, annual average, shown as 1,000 ÷ the published NGN per US$.
